title: Production readiness review
description: Complete the controls that make the search index recoverable, bounded, observable, and secure.

groups.title: Build these controls
items: Define explicit mappings and representative relevance tests before indexing production data.
Benchmark shard plans with realistic documents, queries, indexing load, and recovery traffic.
Keep a replayable source or outbox and make indexing idempotent by stable document ID and version.
Automate snapshots and rehearse a timed restore into an isolated cluster.
Set query, aggregation, pagination, and tenant limits at the application boundary.
Alert on unassigned shards, disk watermarks, rejected work, merge pressure, and indexing lag.

groups.title: Reject these shortcuts
items: Treat replica shards as backups for accidental deletion or bad writes.
Allow arbitrary user-supplied query DSL, scripts, index names, or bucket counts.
Change mappings in place without a generation, validation, cutover, and rollback plan.
Choose shard counts from node count alone without estimating future bytes and recovery time.
Assume a successful source write is immediately visible to search without measuring refresh lag.
Expose cluster administration credentials to an application service.
